message.content:
Switched the copy constructor to member-initializer-list copy construction, so each vector is copy-constructed directly instead of being default-constructed and then assigned. This removes the redundant default-construction/assignment path while preserving the exact copied members.

```cpp
FieldBase::FieldBase(const FieldBase &field)
    : values(field.values)
    , stringIndexes(field.stringIndexes)
{
}
```
